name: Glass quote post
oneLiner: someone else's post sits alone on glass; a finger taps repost, a menu opens and Quote is picked, then the post shrinks into a nested card while the composer grows around it (real face, name), the new line types itself above the quote with a filling character ring, and Post is pressed, draining to a green Posted
say: when the speaker reacts to something someone else posted ('so I quoted it and said...', 'someone asked this and I had to answer'): cut in on the question, the new line types as they say their take and Posted lands on the end of it
